promises.label: Expand Venezuelan oil production
promises.commitment: Pursue up to 50% Venezuelan joint-venture production growth over the next 18–24 months, subject to additional U.S. authorizations.
promises.outcomeSummary: Production grew 15%; 50% growth shifted to the end of 2028, followed by plans for roughly 600 thousand barrels of oil per day by 2031.

missing.what_was_said: Mike Wirth said the existing operating model had delivered production growth during 2026, but Chevron needed further progress before putting more capital to work in Venezuela.

Management said Venezuelan gross production was on track to reach around 300,000 barrels of oil per day by year-end 2026, up 20% over the preceding 12 months. This was a forecast, not a declaration that the 50% growth target had been achieved.

promises.outcomeSummary: The greater than 10% annual adjusted free cash flow growth target through 2030 at $70 Brent remains unchanged and pending; management called the broader plan on track.
